known_limits: a bare value that is a single digit cannot be located reliably by a literal test, and every miss on the truth test and every leak on the cross-question test is of that kind
a value the corpus implies but does not state verbatim -- a derived figure -- is scored unsupported, because the evidence does not literally contain it
the entailment model is strict about definitional fragments, which is why the literal test exists alongside it, and lenient about bare numbers, which is why a bare value is not put to it at all
